sections.heading: Constant Contact limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Lite with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain email campaigns at the expense of Campaign/automation depth vs design simplicity — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Lite · email campaigns | Standard | Premium.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Constant Contact
sections.body:

Decision conclusion: buy Constant Contact when researched fit (Local SMBs and nonprofits needing brand-familiar email marketing) beats researched limits (No forever-free plan — trial-only entry); otherwise keep researching — do not substitute product names into a generic implementation essay.
